title: CriticaLLM: Using LLMs as Autonomous Game Master for Tabletop Role-Playing Games
abstract: arXiv:2610.21525v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive capabilities across many tasks, including processing large amounts of text, following instructions, and generating ideas. This allows the use of such models in various contexts, including games and Tabletop Role-Playing Games (TTRPGs), such as Dungeons & Dragons. However, these games include many complex components, from crafting interesting stories to adhering to rules, while allowing some freedom in players' actions. In this work, we first highlight key components that LLMs should exhibit in the context of TTRPGs. Then, we introduce our framework, CriticaLLM, a fully automated Game Master that can run entire TTRPG games, from creating diverse and interesting stories to managing exploration and combat phases. translated_title: CriticaLLM：使用大语言模型作为桌面角色扮演游戏的自主游戏主持人
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在众多任务中展现出了令人印象深刻的能力，包括处理大量文本、遵循指令和生成创意。这使得此类模型能够应用于各种场景，包括游戏和桌面角色扮演游戏（TTRPG），例如《龙与地下城》。然而，这类游戏包含许多复杂的组成部分，既要构建有趣的故事、遵守游戏规则，又要允许玩家行动拥有一定的自由度。在这项工作中，我们首先强调了大语言模型在桌面角色扮演游戏情境中应具备的关键要素。随后，我们介绍了我们的框架 CriticaLLM，这是一个完全自动化的游戏主持人（Game Master），能够运行完整的桌面角色扮演游戏，从创建多样且有趣的故事，到管理探索阶段和战斗阶段。我们邀请真实的桌面角色扮演游戏玩家对我们的框架进行了评估，并检验了四种不同规模的大语言模型所生成情节和反派的多样性。总体而言，我们的框架表现出……
tldr: 该论文提出了CriticaLLM框架，这是一个完全由大语言模型驱动的自动化游戏主持人，能够独立运行完整的桌面角色扮演游戏，涵盖故事创作、探索和战斗管理，并通过真实玩家评估验证了其生成情节的多样性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CriticaLLM, a fully automated LLM-based Game Master framework capable of running complete tabletop role-playing games—from generating diverse and engaging stories to managing exploration and combat phases—validated through evaluations with actual TTRPG players.
